clues.text: At Bethel, a man of God cried out against Jeroboam's altar that a son of David's house would burn human bones on it.
He was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.
This king of Judah read the Book of the Covenant, found in the house of the LORD, aloud to all the people.
This king of Judah took the Asherah pole out of the temple, burned it in the Kidron Valley and ground it to powder.
He had Judah keep a Passover in Jerusalem like none kept since the days of the judges.
No king of Judah before or after him turned to the LORD with all his heart, soul and strength.
This king of Judah went out to confront Pharaoh Neco of Egypt and was killed at Megiddo.

taken: King Josiah burned the temple's Asherah pole in this valley, ground it to powder, and threw the dust on graves.
